notes.title: Controller Support Update!

[*]Turned off slow-motion effect by default (Can be turned back on from Gameplay settings)

notes.title: Name The Boss
notes.content:
[b]Choose any name you want[/b] for the [b]Final Boss[/b] in [b]Riot Ride[/b], [b]best name[/b] out of all submissions wins!

[h2]About the boss:[/h2]
An [b]evil disco van[/b] that rams you with its [b]disco ball[/b] and blows you up with its [b]lasers[/b]!
For more info, check out the trailer (end part): https://youtu.be/5s7S7rseEcg

[h2]How To Submit A Name[/h2]
[olist]
[*][url=https://discord.gg/WdkkGbbUKk]Join our Discord server  [/url]
[*]Collect [b]2500 [/b]coins by playing chatting and playing fun games on the server
[*]Buy the Nameplate item using [i]/item buy Nameplate[/i]
[*][i]!use[/i] the item!
[*]Write the name in ⁠the #final-boss-nameplate channel!
[/olist]

[h2]What the name can be[/h2]
[list]
[*]The name must be something [b]related to the description of the boss (A disco van basically)[/b], get creative!
[*]The name must abide by the [b]rules of our Discord server[/b] (no hate, racism, sexism...)
[*]The name [b]mustn't be trademarked![/b]
[/list]

Time for some [b]fun [/b]and [b]creative [/b]names, [url=https://discord.gg/WdkkGbbUKk]join now![/url]
